title: Easy Query
source_topic: ICPC / The 2019 Asia Danang Regional Contest
statement: An array of up to two hundred thousand integers is given together with as many queries. Each query names a contiguous range and a window of positions within that range once the range has been sorted, and asks for the sum of three bitwise ors: over the values occurring at least once, at least twice, and at least three times inside that sorted window. The array is never modified.
